name: Diligence
description: A buyer's review of a target. The firms are instances in the parties vocabulary this domain uses. The target's documents, the clean team, the findings, and which advisor is engaged on which workstream are entities and relationships here, not a separate schema per firm. A confidentiality tier is one enum, used on documents and on findings alike. From v3 the target's grant of access is a delegation, an entity of its own, and a finding names the delegation it was recorded under. From v4 a delegation is narrowed to one workstream, and a finding is reviewed by a second person before it is accepted.

entities.name: Deal
entities.description: The acquisition. Buyer and target are two relationships to the same organization entity.

attributes.name: buyer
attributes.description: The acquiring firm. An instance such as Harbor.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: The firm being acquired. An instance such as Northline.

entities.name: Data room
entities.description: The target's room of documents. Owned by one organization instance.

entities.name: Document
entities.description: A file in the data room. Confidentiality is an enum on the document. Which team it is restricted to is a relationship.

attributes.name: confidentiality
attributes.description: A confidentiality tier is an enum. Who may read it is behavior.

attributes.name: restrictedTo
attributes.description: The team a restricted document is limited to, such as the clean team.

entities.name: Workstream
entities.description: A line of review over the data room. Its deadline is a datetime.

attributes.name: due
attributes.description: When the workstream is due. A deadline is a datetime.

entities.name: Finding
entities.description: Something the review found. Materiality is an enum, and so is its confidentiality tier: a finding drawn from a clean-team document is clean-team itself. The page it rests on lives on a citation, because that connection has a page.

attributes.name: confidentiality
attributes.description: The finding's confidentiality tier, the same tiers as a document's. Who may read it is behavior.

attributes.name: delegation
attributes.description: The delegation the finding was recorded under. Through it the record names the target that granted access, as well as the advisor's firm.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: The second person who reviewed the finding. Not its author; that is the reviewer's to honour and the evaluator's to check.

entities.name: Citation
entities.description: A citation is an entity because the connection between a finding and a document carries a page. A relationship cannot hold that page.

entities.name: Engagement
entities.description: An engagement is an entity because the connection between an advisor firm and a workstream carries a scope and the highest confidentiality tier the firm is cleared to. A relationship cannot hold those. Vale on the financial workstream and Ledger & Kline on the legal one are two engagements, not two kinds of advisor.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: What the advisor is engaged to review.

attributes.name: clearance
attributes.description: The highest confidentiality tier the engaged firm is cleared to on this workstream.

attributes.name: advisor
attributes.description: The engaged firm. An instance such as Vale or Ledger & Kline.

entities.name: Delegation
entities.description: The target's grant of access to its room. It is not the engagement: the engagement is the buyer's arrangement with its advisor, and only the target can open its room. A delegation is an entity because the grant carries a scope, an expiry and a state.

attributes.name: grantor
attributes.description: The firm granting access. For this deal, the target.

attributes.name: grantee
attributes.description: The advisor firm the access is granted to.

attributes.name: workstream
attributes.description: The one workstream the delegation opens the room for.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The widest act the delegation allows. Each scope includes the ones before it.

relationships.name: buys
relationships.description: The deal's buyer. A second relationship joins this same pair of entities for the target.

relationships.name: acquires
relationships.description: The deal's target. The same pair of entities as buys, a different edge.

relationships.name: owns
relationships.description: An organization owns the data room. For this deal that instance is the target.

relationships.name: restricted to
relationships.description: A document is restricted to a team. The clean team is an instance of team in the parties vocabulary.

relationships.name: reviews
relationships.description: A workstream reviews a data room.

relationships.name: in
relationships.description: A finding is raised in a workstream.

relationships.name: raised by
relationships.description: A person raises the finding. Which firm they act for is their membership, in the parties vocabulary.

relationships.name: of
relationships.description: The citation is of a finding. The page stays on the citation.

relationships.name: engages
relationships.description: A workstream engages advisors through its engagements.

relationships.name: engaged as
relationships.description: An organization is engaged as an advisor. The scope and clearance stay on the engagement, not on this edge.

relationships.name: granted by
relationships.description: The firm that granted the delegation.

relationships.name: granted to
relationships.description: The firm the delegation is granted to. The same pair of entities as granted by, a different edge.

relationships.name: opens
relationships.description: The data room the delegation opens.

relationships.name: recorded under
relationships.description: The delegation a finding was recorded under.

relationships.name: for
relationships.description: The workstream a delegation is narrowed to.

relationships.name: reviewed by
relationships.description: The person who reviewed the finding.
